activities.title: Open an opportunity for a replacement soft-serve machine at a repeat Taylor account
activities.trigger: A Taylor Freezer of Arizona account manager calls in after a compressor failure and asks for replacement pricing rather than another repair.
activities.narrative: The salesperson opens a new Opportunity against the existing Account, names the expected close month and the equipment family in play. Nothing downstream is committed: the Opportunity is explicitly pre-commitment and writes nothing into inventory or service (firestore.rules:1734-1739). The Opportunity also takes an operating company at creation, copied from the explicit value or inherited — never inferred from the salesperson or the customer.

activities.title: Refuse to open an opportunity on an ownerless account
activities.trigger: An account imported from the legacy system has never had an account owner assigned.
activities.narrative: The Opportunity inherits its owner from the parent Account owner. The ownership matrix records that an ownerless Account makes inherited Opportunity creation REFUSE, by design, and that ruling D-6 forbids inferring the Account owner from creator, territory, coverage, activity, sales history or auth uid. The salesperson must get the Account owned first; there is no fallback.

activities.title: Read an opportunity from the browser without going through a callable
activities.trigger: A developer or an integration attempting a direct Firestore read.
activities.narrative: Denied in Rules for every principal including admin. A governed client read model, if any, is recorded as a later and separately-authorized change.
activities.authority_path: firestore.rules:1740-1742 `allow read, write: if false`, with the rationale at :1734-1739.
activities.blocking_mechanism: RULES_DENY — firestore.rules:1741 denies read and write unconditionally for every principal; the comment at :1739 records that a governed client READ model is a later, separately-authorized change.

activities.title: Have the sales manager who booked the order also allocate it
activities.trigger: A small order the sales manager wants to push through end to end.
activities.narrative: They cannot. Executing the resolver across all 48 roles shows salesOrder.fulfill and salesOrder.service are held only by the compatibility roles admin and dispatcher plus owner. Sales Manager, General Manager, Operations Manager, Warehouse Manager and Salesperson all resolve DENY/noQualifyingGrant even with the sandbox activation set applied. The capability that moves a booked order into fulfilment belongs to no governed business role.
